supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate extension visible beyond the lateral canthus

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: significant contrast between the light pinkish-tan muzzle/forehead and the dark-pigmented periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: visible 2D vertical thickness with a distinct structural droop of the lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: a prominent, bright red raw lesion or wound is visible on the bridge of the nose
other_distinctive_markers: extensive dark mottling and freckling across the light skin of the muzzle and face
